name: scientific-skills
description: Agent Skills for scientific research and manuscript production: figure standards with an executable checker, editorial polish, the fixed front and end matter of a paper, a literature search and citation verifier across four open indexes, a discipline for interpreting results, a statistical-validity review, a research feasibility protocol, an audit for the analysis failures that return a plausible result instead of an error, a hostile peer-review rehearsal, and a simulation of the editor's desk-reject screen.
